ambient_events: The stove is fed one stick and the door shut quietly.
A curtain is pulled round a bed by somebody who doesn't look in first.
Somebody very small is being talked to, at length, about nothing.
A name goes up on one of the small shelves. Chalk, not paint, and nobody remarks on why.
description:
Warm and quiet, bigger inside than the door suggests. Beds along one wall with curtains that pull round, a stove, a worn rocking chair, and a wall of small shelves each chalked with a name.

By the door, the numbers of what went wrong, written on the wall.
name: The Whelping Room
